cells.gaps: No evidence row is held on local government revenue records. What is held instead is DIGI-CoR, an enabling programme for the decentralised local authorities still seeking financing in June 2026; SIGIT, the central tax directorate's system, unclassified, whose offices include the Centres de Fiscalité Locale et des Particuliers; and a planned digital land register for the Communauté urbaine de Douala. Whether any commune keeps a digital revenue record is not established.
cells.note: No row on the sub-indicator, so no rung can be set. No system held is of class survey or central, so neither flag is set.
